howto.name: Type or paste your input
howto.text: Or upload a file. Files are read into the browser via FileReader.

howto.name: Choose hash algorithm
howto.text: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512. SHA-256 is the modern recommendation.

howto.name: Copy the hex digest
howto.text: Runs entirely in your browser using the Web Crypto API. Input never leaves your machine.

faq.a: For non-security purposes (file integrity, deduplication): yes. For security (passwords, signatures): no — MD5 is broken. Use SHA-256 or SHA-512.
Verifying file integrity after download, deduplication, change detection, content-addressed storage.

faq.q: Is the hash calculation done in the browser?
faq.a: Yes — Web Crypto API runs the hash in your browser. Files are not uploaded.
